application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: 1 x London plane (T54):Reduce upper crown height by 6-8m to suitable branch unions to provide even and flowing canopy outline for regenerative growth.Reduce upper east leader by 5-7m to draw in over-extended crown above previously reduced leader beneath.Prune previously reduced east leader developing from cavity where not regenerated by up to a further 1.5m to encourage regenerative growth.Reduce south west leader developing from cavity by 6-7m to suitable unions to give even and flowing canopy outline for regenerative growth.Remove central western leader - Massaria damaged limb - back to main stem at approximately 12m height.Reduce north west leader by 3-4m to suitable unions.Any remaining outstanding spread / height reduce by up to 3-4m to bring into line with remainder of reduced crown shape.1 x London plane (T61):Reduce northern upright leader with bracing attached by 2-3m to suitable unions to reduce over-extended form and retain even and flowing canopy outline (Inonotus hispidus fruiting bracket identified at 12m above cobra bracing).See images in submitted report reference AAN01/AS/MF/0147/25, addendum note 12 December 2025.
